lead: Dharmendra was a film actor, born on 8 December 1935 in Nasrali.
He died on 24 November 2025 in Mumbai at the age of 89.
He has 60 credited works on public record and has held the office of Member of the 14th Lok Sabha.
Below you will find a verified overview of Dharmendra: age, height, birthplace, family background, education, career milestones and awards, each drawn from open public records.

paras: Net-worth figures for Dharmendra circulate widely online, but almost none of them come from an audited or officially published source. BioStar does not invent or repeat unsourced numbers, so no dollar figure is stated on this page.
